notes: This is the task where the new corpora most clearly beat the old pool. CalibForge is decisively the best source: it has multiple tasks that reproduce the TB premise almost exactly (debug passes / release crashes, O0-vs-O2 divergence, custom pool-allocator corruption, plus an explicit 'pass Valgrind' task), and they are well verified (strong/ok). Terminal-Lego contributes the single best-worded match, task_07249 ('C++ program that only crashes with optimizations'), plus a real Valgrind task. TMax has a deep bench of C/C++ memory-leak and segfault-fix tasks but none tie the crash to optimization level, so it sits just below. SWE-Smith and SWE-Rebench have essentially no C++ heap-corruption content; their best entries are conan compiler-flag fixes (domain-adjacent) and a memray fix, all overall 1-2 and should be treated as filler. Recursive-Task-Synthesis only offers build/compile chores (some share the /build layout) and one GDB-crash-capture task; all absent-verifier and low transfer. No FREE candidate is in final_top10 (tw_7829 and tw_104501, both strong skill matches, are FREE and kept in TerminalWorld per_source only).
